operator-walkthrough.deferred: operator-pending (2026-10-08, camera N-series PR B after its review round): each camera card on Admin > Lot replaces the 'steady today' / 'N drops today' text with a HealthTimeline strip (today's state segments over the business window: emerald HEALTHY, sky EXPECTED_SOLAR_OFFLINE, grey UNKNOWN for the stretch no row covers, amber/red for the rest; the current state and how long it has held above it; the changes and drops count beneath it, STALE no longer counted as a drop), reconciled with the state the read itself derives so a dead producer's last minutes are not drawn as watched; and the trust strip gains a 'Watched today' chip (the sign camera's HEALTHY share of ALL business time so far, floored; one cell per business hour coloured grey for no record, sky for expected dark on its battery, emerald/amber/red by the hour's expected-watch share; 'N min expected dark (solar)' in the detail; 'shop not open yet' before open, 'no business hours today' without hours) that turns amber when the EXPECTED-watch share is under 80%, because the comparison with the baseline is then withheld. What the operator sees on the first day after deploy: segments from the first recorded row onward (UNKNOWN before it), the read-derived states from the first 5-minute alert tick stamped where they began rather than at the tick, and the solar morning shown as expected dark rather than withholding the comparison. Before the review round the health read would have returned ok:false on the first anchored day (the P0: `Cannot access 'str' before initialization`), so the whole card set would have shown the read failure; that is now executed in server/routers/lotHealth.test.ts. After the second round (the Codex review of #2927, read after that merge): at night the solar sign camera with its edge still posting reads 'expected solar offline' for as long as it has actually been dark (it read 'dark for 20 s' all night) and no longer leaves a camera-offline drop in the day's count every evening; the header's marked-car counts drop a mark the operator undid with Clear. Also in this PR, the four nickstire Codex findings on #2920 (lot.activity counts episodes like the headline counter; the open-only floor board is read oldest first with a 7-day floor; a restarted edge reads 'warming' and is held like quiet; a recovery after a frozen-capture page is reported at once because the claim payload records the vision and frames facets). Receipts on the merged tree (main 0f9453df merged in at 689a62ae): pnpm run check 0 errors; typecheck:raw exit 0; vitest full suite run alone 959 files: 954 passed, 2 failed, 3 skipped; 11,715 tests: 11,653 passed, 2 failed, 59 skipped, 1 todo, read from the vitest summary line (the two reds are outside this diff and reported in the PR body: the caption font test, red the same way with sources identical to main, and a 30-second timeout in the corpus claim scan, whose file passes 138 of 138 when run alone with a longer timeout); the six fix-round files 143 passed and fourteen neighbouring files 190 passed; every new or changed test first run against the pushed head 2eee1c18 and red for its named reason (38 reds, 7 files); lint:source, lint:hooks, lint:sql, lint:curdate, lint:cron-wiring (0 faults), validate:routes, prettier, lint:brand-voice (staged, 0 violations), lint:pii (staged, clean), lint:orphans (0 NEW) green; capability ledger valid (133); build exit 0. One pre-existing red in this container, server/captionSafeZone.test.ts (DejaVu Bold wider than the Arial-tuned budget; sources identical to main), disclosed in the PR body. No lefthook hooks are installed in the cloud checkout, so the gates ran by hand and CI runs them again. A live look on the operator's phone is the walkthrough.
